title: feat(slash-commands): type/source indicators, skill invocation & argument hints
author: Drilmo
lessons: Feature PRs should not bundle formatter output -- unrelated formatting changes increase merge conflict surface
Duplicate message handlers (ExtensionStateContext + InstalledSkillsView) create independent state copies
Priority chains (built-in > workflow > skill) need explicit documentation comments
Incremental spec adoption (argument-hint from Agent Skills spec) is a good pattern for feature PRs
Long-lived branches in fast-moving codebases predictably accumulate merge conflicts
